data.one_liner: Provides a bubble-style indicator for TabBar in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Adds a bubble-shaped visual indicator to a TabBar. The indicator can be customized with height, color, radius and padding. It works on all Flutter platforms supported by the package.
use_when: You want a simple bubble effect for tabs without writing custom painter code
You need a lightweight, zero‑dependency solution for TabBar styling
avoid_when: You require complex animations or highly custom shapes for the indicator
You need a package that is officially published on pub.dev
strengths: Very easy to integrate via the TabBar widget
No extra dependencies beyond Flutter itself
weaknesses: Limited customization options compared to writing your own painter
Package is not yet published on pub.dev, requiring GitHub reference
data.minimal_example:
TabBar(
  indicatorSize: TabBarIndicatorSize.tab,
  indicator: BubbleTabIndicator(
    indicatorHeight: 25.0,
    indicatorColor: Colors.blueAccent,
    tabBarIndicatorSize: TabBarIndicatorSize.tab,
  ),
)
